Image 1 is the reference; image 2 is first available rendered step (or final if no steps); image 3, if present, is the last/final selected render. Compare observed 2D multi-object coverage, material/texture detail, visible part adjacency, pose, camera/perspective and lighting/render issues. Separate directly visible observations from geometric hypotheses. Pixels do not establish physical contact, hidden object count, teacher diagnosis, student adoption or causal improvement. This case is a deterministic small sample, not a conclusion about all Scene RSI experiments. No numeric quality score or new scene code. Cite image numbers and source paths, including uncertainty from occlusion and rendering.
